jobs.title: (Senior) System Engineer Digital Solutions R&D
jobs.description:
Mainz, Germany \| full time \| Job ID: 11788

 **About the Role:**

  



BioNTech SE currently runs a variety of digitalization projects including SAP ERP, MES and LIMS systems. As part of our growth activities our digital solutions will be extended by a global LIMS Platform for the research and development/ scientific part at BioNTech and we want to increase our efforts to bring more digital solutions in to support our R\&D processes. Thus, a global R\&D digital ecosystem including various capabilities is currently rolled out to our labs.

  



As Senior System Engineer, you will be part of the team that builds, deploys and runs software solutions to support the digitalization of R\&D labs. You will be taking over strategic responsibility in all phases of the lifecycle of assigned software systems, from ideation over implementation to maintenance. In the solutioning phase, it is the responsibility to identify the most suitable solution for the underlying business needs in alignment with the respective governance and frame conditions. As the owner of the applications, the Senior System Engineer Service Owner aligns all activities with the stakeholders (business partners, domain architect) and makes sure that the solutions meet the user requirements.

  



With a very high level of domain expertise and strategic competence in R\&D Lab Systems, you work cross functional through the application and project life cycle to ensure consistent processes delivered according to our standards for the designated application area(s).

  


**Your Contribution:**

  


* **Solution Design:** Identify the most suitable technical solutions for complex business needs, ensuring alignment with IT governance and strategic frameworks.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the central interface between business partners, technical teams, and domain architects to ensure solutions meet user requirements and corporate standards.
* **Strategic Advisory:** Leverage your deep expertise in R\&D lab systems (e.g., ELN, SDMS, Automation, Data Evaluation) to provide market insights and drive the application roadmap.
* **Project Delivery:** Lead the technical change management and ensure the successful, compliant delivery of assigned software projects.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Ensure long\-term stakeholder satisfaction by maintaining a high\-performing and scalable software landscape.
  


**A Good Match:**

  


* Degree in Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in pharma, IT operations, or process management.
* Strong technical affinity to identify best suitable technical solutions for complex challenges.
* Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell is required; basic familiarity with modern programming languages such as Java or C\# is considered a plus.
* Understanding of common device communication standards, such as OPC UA/DA and SiLA2 appreciated.
* Very strong communication skills with fluency in English required, and advanced proficiency in German is considered a plus.

  


**Your Benefits:**

  



It's our priority to support you:


* Your flexibility: flexible hours \| vacation account
* Your growth: Digital Learning \| Performance \& talent development \| leadership development \| Apprenticeships \| LinkedIn Learning
* Your value: Your voice at the table \| Culture on an equal footing \| Opportunities to shape \& impact \| Support for your full potential
* Your health and lifestyle: Company bike
* Your mobility: Job ticket \| Deutschlandticket
* Your life phases: Employer\-funded pension \| Childcare

  


**Apply now \- We look forward to your application!**

  



Apply to our Mainz, Germany location by sending us your documents via our online form. For any questions, contact our talent acquisition team on: \+ 49 (0\) 6131\-9084\-1291 (Monday\-Friday from 1 PM to 3 PM CET).

  



Job ID 11788 (please always specify if you have any questions)

  




By submitting your application, you acknowledge that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. If you are considered for the position, BioNTech will conduct the background check through our service provider ‘HireRight’. You will be informed accordingly by your BioNTech\-Recruiter.



Note for applications within Europe: Please note that if you wish to claim travel expenses incurred in connection with an in\-person interview, we are obliged to carry out a sanctions list check\*. This is carried out by our partner, HireRight. Travel expenses will only be reimbursed if this sanctions list check does not yield any matches. Reimbursement can be made provided that the check is successfully completed.  

  

* Your first name, surname and date of birth will be processed for the sanctions list check. The legal basis for carrying out the sanctions list check for positions at BioNTech in Europe is BioNTech’s legitimate interest. Please note that BioNTech will not carry out the sanctions list check if no travel expenses are to be reimbursed. If you do not give BioNTech your consent to the sanctions list check, your travel expenses cannot be reimbursed. This will not affect your application.

**Inspired? Become part of \#TeamBioNTech.**


**BioNTech, the story**


At BioNTech, we are more than just a biotechnology company – we are a community of innovators, scientists, and leaders dedicated to revolutionizing medicine by translating cutting\-edge science into survival. Your contributions here have the potential to improve the health of people worldwide, especially by addressing diseases with high medical needs like cancer and various infectious diseases.


Experience a dynamic workplace that embraces diversity in all its forms. We foster innovation, encourage creativity, and develop business strategies driven by our shared passion for advancing medicine.


Working at BioNTech means striving to achieve medical breakthroughs while growing your career in a meaningful way. Apply today and become part of a mission that has the potential to change lives around the world.


BioNTech does not tolerate discrimination, favoritism or harassment based on gender, political views, religion or belief, nationality, ethnic or social origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, physical appearance, health status or any other physical or personal characteristics. BioNTech is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. The main thing is that you suit us, and we suit you!

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (m/w/d)
Unbefristet
**Über Heraeus**


Displays faltbar machen? Herzen mit Mikro\-Teilchen beim Schlagen helfen? Oder Edelmetallen neues Leben einhauchen? Als globale Technologiegruppe in Familienbesitz unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, stets einen Schritt voraus zu sein.

  

  

**Über Heraeus Covantics**


Wir sind einer der führenden Werkstoffspezialisten für die Herstellung und Verarbeitung von hochreinem Quarzglas und anderen hochwertigen Materialien wie Keramik und neuartigen Kompositen. Mit einem globalen Team von über 2\.000 Mitarbeitenden und Standorten in Europa, den USA und Asien sind wir spezialisiert auf die Fertigung von Halbzeugen, komplexen Systemkomponenten und individuellen Lösungen für die Informations\- und Telekommunikationsbranche, die Herstellung von Spezialfasern für industrielle und medizinische Anwendungen, die Halbleiterfertigung und die Optik.
  

Bei uns erwartet Sie ein innovationsgetriebenes Arbeitsumfeld, globale Zusammenarbeit im Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv soziale und ökologische Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!


  
**Das können Sie bewegen:**
  
* Im Rahmen ihrer Tätigkeit entwickeln sie hardwarenahe Software für Messgeräte, Sensoren und Aktoren und optimieren bestehende Anwendungen kontinuierlich.
* Darüber hinaus konzipieren, programmieren und erweitern sie Messprogramme sowie Steuerungen für messtechnische Anlagen.
* Zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs analysieren sie Fehler, führen Wartungsmaßnahmen durch und beheben Störungen an Messsystemen.
* Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ihrer Arbeit liegt in der Verarbeitung, Auswertung und Bereitstellung von Mess\- und Rohdaten.
* Zudem entwickeln und dokumentieren sie Benutzerschnittstellen (HMIs) sowie Programmierschnittstellen (APIs) für unterschiedliche Anwendungsbereiche.
* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern treiben sie die Weiterentwicklung der Softwarestrategie für messtechnische Anlagen voran und unterstützen die Inbetriebnahme neuer Systeme.
* Ergänzend hierzu erstellen sie Bedienungs\- und Schulungsunterlagen und führen Anwenderschulungen für Mitarbeitende durch.


  
**Das bringen Sie mit:**


  
* Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informationssystemtechnik, Technischen Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C/C\+\+, C\#, Python sowie Skript\- und Datenbanksprachen
* Fundierte Erfahrung im Software\-Engineering, insbesondere Anforderungsanalyse, Softwareentwurf und Schnittstellendesign
* Grundkenntnisse in Scientific Computing, Messtechnik und Sensorik
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit sowie selbstständige Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und Bereitschaft zur Einarbeitung in neue Aufgabenfelder


  
**Worauf Sie sich bei Heraeus Covantics freuen können:**
  
* **Attraktive Vergütung –** starkes Grundgehalt nach Chemie\-Tarifvertrag, jährliche Einmalzahlungen (Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld, Zukunftsbetrag), Altersfreizeiten sowie Erweiterung der gesetzlichen Pflegeversicherung um eine Pflegezusatzversicherung
* **Finanzielle Zusatzleistungen –** Förderung der privaten Altersversorgung, Lebensphasenkonto für bezahlte Freistellungen (z.B. Sabbatical, früherer Eintritt in den Ruhestand), Bezuschussung ÖPNV, Rabatte in vielen (Online\-)Shops
* **Geregelte Arbeitszeiten –** 37,5 Wochenstunden, Freizeitausgleich für Überstunden, Altersfreizeiten, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
* **Gesundheit \& Wohlbefinden –** betriebsärztlicher Dienst mit umfassenden Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, Sportangebote, Sozialberatung und hauseigene Mitarbeiterkantine mit täglich frisch zubereiteten Speisen


  
**Neugierig? Jetzt bewerben!**


Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Unterlagen mit dem Referenzcode **60097** über unser Online\-Bewerbungsportal.
  

  

**Noch Fragen?**


Unser Recruiting Team, Heraeus Covantics, ist gerne per Mail für Sie da: HCT\-HR\_koh@heraeus.com. Oder besuchen Sie uns unter jobs.heraeus.com.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Key Accounts (AI Solutions)
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.


Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.


Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.


At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We’re customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

  

You'll be the technical partner for a portfolio of Aircall's strategic global accounts, working closely with Key Account Managers to drive agentic AI adoption use case by use case, from the first deployed use case to broader expansion.


**About the Team**


Aircall's Forward Deployed Engineering team connects our innovative AI Agents technology to real\-world customer workflows. We turn possibility into production by delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact.


Within that team, this is a hands\-on, Key Accounts–focused role for someone who wants to go deep rather than broad, working with a portfolio of Aircall's strategic customers and growing agentic adoption inside each one over time. It sits at the intersection of technical consulting, project delivery, and AI adoption. You don't need to be a full\-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, confident managing technical projects, and comfortable working with customer stakeholders.


**About the Role**


As a Forward Deployed Engineer for Key Accounts, you are the technical point of contact for a portfolio of Aircall's strategic customers. You don't run a deployment and move on. You stay with the account and help build its agentic roadmap alongside the Key Account Manager (KAM).


You help land a first high\-impact use case, prove value fast, then expand the footprint use case by use case. You'll work closely with the KAM, senior FDEs, Product, and Engineering, taking on increasing ownership of your accounts as you grow in the role.


Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue\-driving role spanning Solutions Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership.


**What you'll do**


* Build ongoing relationships with the accounts in your portfolio as their go\-to technical contact for Aircall's AI Agents.
* Partner with the Key Account Manager on the account plan: the KAM owns the commercial relationship and quota. You own technical execution and contribute to the use\-case roadmap and the pipeline of expansion opportunities.
* Deliver the first use case fast, then expand. Deploy an initial high\-value workflow, track the outcome, and use proven value to identify the next use case.
* Run regular use\-case discovery with customer teams to surface, qualify, and prioritise new automation opportunities.
* Act as a trusted advisor to your accounts on agentic AI. Help them build their AI roadmap 6–12 months out, not just the deployment in front of you, and keep Aircall positioned as their platform of choice.
* Lead discovery and solution\-design sessions with customer stakeholders to map business processes, identify automation opportunities, and define solution architecture.
* Design, build, and deploy integrations using low/no\-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation tools (HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow) with API connectors.
* Configure and optimise the AI Agent, defining intents, prompts, actions, guardrails, and performance metrics tailored to each account's workflows.
* Manage cross\-functional deployments: define timelines, align stakeholders, ensure accountability, and deliver on time and within scope.
* Collaborate with Engineering to validate technical feasibility, resolve blockers, and share field learnings that inform product improvements.
* Create scalable models and reusable frameworks (templates, playbooks, reference architectures) that make expansion within Key Accounts faster and more consistent.
* Champion continuous learning and enablement. Train peers, run internal workshops, and document best practices to raise the technical bar across the team.
* Collaborate with GTM leadership on the routines and cadences that drive accountability for expansion pipeline, forecast accuracy, and performance tracking within Key Accounts.
* Contribute to expansion pipeline and MRR within your portfolio, jointly with the KAM.
* Share customer needs, integration insights, and field learnings with Product and PMM to help shape the AI Agent roadmap.
* Support internal and external product education, including enablement for System Integrators (SIs) and channel partners where they support your accounts.
* Maintain awareness of AI and CX industry trends, ensuring insights feed back into product and GTM strategy.

**What you'll bring**


* 2–5 years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or integration\-focused project management, ideally with some exposure to larger or enterprise accounts.
* Client\-facing experience required, ideally working alongside sales or account management teams.
* Technical skills:
	+ Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL), with the ability to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.
	+ Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.
* Tools experience:
	+ Hands\-on experience with low\-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects, working with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating between technical and business audiences.
* A growth mindset: constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.
* Nice\-to\-haves:
	+ Experience in telephony, voice, or contact centre systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).
	+ Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).
	+ Exposure to scripting (JavaScript/Python) for light customisation and debugging.

**What success looks like**


* A growing number of live agentic use cases within each account in your portfolio.
* Shortened time\-to\-first\-value on the initial use case, then a repeatable path to use case two and beyond.
* Contribution to net revenue retention and expansion MRR across your portfolio, jointly with the KAM.
* Strong, trusted working relationships with customer stakeholders.
* Reusable frameworks, models, and templates actively used by peers and partners.
* Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.
* Sustained improvements in customer metrics (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions.
**Why join us?**


Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities


‍* ️ Our people matter, work\-life balance is important at Aircall


Fast\-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit


45\+ Nationalities: cosmopolite \& multi\-cultural mindset


Competitive salary package \& benefits

  

**DE\&I Statement:**


At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.


We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.


We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

  

Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Medical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
The post holder will work as part of a diverse and multidisciplinary Medical Equipment Management Service team to ensure the safe use of medical devices across the Trust. The post holder will carry out acceptance testing, servicing and repair of complex medical equipment and devices. They will take part in workshop rotas and timetables and maintain records of all completed work timely and accurately on the comprehensive equipment management information technology system. Where necessary the post holder will undertake training to develop, upskill and fulfil the evolving needs of the role.
  
  

Technical
  
  

Following standard operating procedures, carry out the following on complex electrical and mechanical
  
  

**Medical equipment:**  

Formal acceptance tests
  
Performance tests
  
Planned Preventative Maintenance
  
Servicing / Routine maintenance
  
  

Under the supervision of senior technicians, analyse and diagnose faults in complex electrical and mechanical medical equipment and calibrate and operate test equipment correctly.
  
  

Carry out electrical safety testing of equipment.
  
  

The Trust provides a full range of local and specialist services across its five sites. In June 2026, we launched our new strategy for 2026\-31\. Our vision is to transform healthcare, and we have agreed six strategic ambitions to help us improve care for patients, and the working lives of our staff.
  
  

Our six strategic ambitions are delivering high\-quality patient care ; creating a great place to work ; leading pioneering research, innovation and education ; building strong and successful partnerships ; providing timely and efficient care ; and ensuring long\-term financial sustainability .
  
  

We have also agreed four new organisational values – Caring, Collaborative, Inclusive, Innovative – and these underpin everything we do, and how our teams interact with the patients under our care.
  
  

We are at a pivotal point in our history and we require individuals who are ready to join a highly professional team and make a real, lasting difference to our patients and our people.
  
  

King’s is committed to delivering Sustainable Healthcare for All via our Green Plan. In line with national Greener NHS ambitions, we have set net zero carbon targets of 2040 for our NHS Carbon Footprint and 2045 for our NHS Carbon Footprint Plus. Everyone’s contribution is required in order to meet the goals set out in our Green Plan and we encourage all staff to work responsibly, minimising their contributions to the Trust’s carbon emissions, waste and pollution wherever possible.
  
  

Communication
  
  

Provide technical information and feedback to clinical users on the service and repair of equipment.
  
Communicate with equipment suppliers and manufacturers regarding maintenance and repair of medical equipment.
  
Collaborate with other technical staff in the maintenance of medical equipment.
  
  

Clinical
  
  

Attend clinical areas to carry out routine maintenance of medical equipment, either alone or with colleagues
  
  

Quality Control
  
  

Adhere to the processes and procedures as described in the quality manual.
  
Comment on proposed changes to departmental policies and procedures.
  
  

Records
  
  

Accurately and clearly record work done on the medical equipment management database.
  
Check that information provided on equipment is correct, that procedures for adding and updating information is followed and any anomalies are reported to the team leader.
  
  

Time Management
  
  

Plans own workload and prioritises breakdown requests allocated to self.
  
Organises routine maintenance duties allocated to self.
  
  

Physical
  
  

Assist with the movement and transport of equipment and packages, of up to 20kgs, to and from clinical areas, and between MEMS sites.
  
Carry out repetitive equipment testing which may require working in awkward positions where testing carried out on\-site.

jobs.title: Process Design & Development Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Process Design \& Development Engineer – MPD Process Development**

**Wotton under Edge**

**up to £40,000 depending on experience**

 **The purpose of the role**

  

Renishaw's Machine Tool Products Division (MPD) is looking for a Process Design \& Development Engineer to join the Process Software Team. This is a multidisciplinary engineering role focused on the development of automated assembly and test systems used throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept evaluation through to full production. Working within a focused and collaborative team, you will design, develop, validate and implement innovative test rigs, manufacturing processes and automation solutions, combining mechanical, electrical and software engineering disciplines to deliver robust and capable systems.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and develop automated assembly and test systems for new and existing products.
* Work closely with product development teams from concept through to production to define process and test requirements.
* Design, prototype and validate test equipment, tooling, fixtures and manufacturing processes.
* Develop software solutions using technologies such as C\#, LabVIEW, PLC and SQL to control, monitor and analyse automated systems.
* Integrate sensors, instrumentation, motion control and data acquisition technologies into complex test environments.
* Analyse test and process data to validate performance, capability and measurement system effectiveness.
* Produce clear documentation including requirements specifications, design documentation, validation reports and handover information.
* Work with manufacturing, NPI, project teams and specialist engineering groups to ensure solutions are safe, robust, efficient and manufacturable.
* Investigate production and yield issues, identifying improvements to both products and processes.
* Support continuous improvement activities across assembly, test and manufacturing operations.
* Manage or support the sourcing, procurement and implementation of equipment and tooling required for new processes.

 **Key Requirements**

* Degree, HNC/HND or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
* Experience with software development (e.g. C\#, LabVIEW, PLC) for the design or support of automated test systems, manufacturing equipment, and production processes.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyse data and apply engineering judgement to drive decisions and improvements.
* Experience working within a structured engineering environment, including design reviews, validation activities and documentation.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Desire to be hands on outside of the core day\-to\-day functions, debugging rig issues or satisfying customer orders where necessary (bespoke rig builds).

  



**Desirable Requirements**

* Understanding of precision assembly or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of statistical process control, Gauge R\&R, MSA, CpK and process capability analysis.
* Experience with CAD packages such as Siemens NX or equivalent.
* Understanding of electrical design, control systems or industrial communications.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar project management and software version control tools.
* Experience developing production test equipment or manufacturing automation solutions.
* Knowledge of DfM, DfA, Process FMEA or Six Sigma methodologies.

 **Person Specification**

  

The successful applicant will be a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. They will be comfortable working across multiple engineering disciplines and keen to develop new skills outside their primary area of expertise.


They will demonstrate:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Clear communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality engineering solutions.
* Attention to detail and a methodical approach to engineering activities.
* A willingness to learn and collaborate with specialists from different disciplines.
* The ability to balance practical hands\-on work with engineering rigour and documentation.

 **Opportunities for Career Development and Training**

  

We are committed to supporting engineers in developing broad, multidisciplinary skill sets. The successful candidate will have opportunities to gain experience across software, electronics, mechanical design and systems engineering while contributing to real\-world automation and manufacturing challenges.

  

Training and development opportunities include:

* C\# and software development training.
* NI training and development programmes for LabVIEW.
* Siemens NX and mechanical design training.
* Mentoring and technical reviews from experienced software, electronics and mechanical engineers.
* Training in process validation, measurement systems analysis and manufacturing statistics.
* Exposure to full product lifecycle development, from concept through to production deployment.
* Internal professional development courses including presentation skills, report writing, project management and leadership.
* Opportunities to pursue additional technical or professional training aligned with business and personal development goals.

 **Benefits**

  

When you join Renishaw, we're committing to your future career. That's because we believe in developing our people's skills and promoting them internally. We also offer a benefits package that's highly desirable; including a 9% non\-contributory pension, discretionary annual bonus, \*subsidised onsite restaurants and \*coffee shops, free parking, \*car sharing scheme and \*24 hour fitness centres. ( not available at all sites).

  

We also want to promote a healthy work\-life balance as much as possible, so we have introduced a hybrid working policy which allows for a combination of home and office based working depending on the nature of your role. We also offer a variable working programme, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, Life Assurance policy of 12 times annual salary, Cycle to Work scheme, enhanced maternity pay subject to qualifying criteria, Health Cash Plan, the option to join Renishaw Health Trust (Aviva) and an Employee Assistance Programme for employees and family.

  

Please click here for further information about our benefits.

  

At Renishaw we believe that our success is powered by welcoming a workforce of diverse and talented people. Through encouraging an inclusive culture, where all our employees are free to be themselves, we can achieve our core values: Innovation, Inspiration, Integrity, and Involvement.  

  

If you are excited about the role but feel as though you don’t meet all the requirements, we would encourage you still to apply. You might just be the right person for this role or another opportunity at Renishaw.  

  

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments to make interviews and jobs more accessible. Should you have any difficulty during the recruitment process, or require any reasonable adjustments please contact the recruitment team on 01453 490384 or recruitment@renishaw.com.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Anthesis Ltd is a dynamic consultancy specializing in software solutions for enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including IFS and Infor M3\. We serve organizations across Europe, and North America delivering tailored services to maximize their ERP investments through responsive and cost\-effective solutions. Our commitment to excellent communication and high\-quality service drives our reputation and repeat business.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a passionate and energetic Software Developer based in Sri Lanka to join our innovative team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance and support related services for integration products and bespoke applications that Anthesis have developed for clients.In includes building high\-quality desktop and server\-based applications to specification for Anthesis clients.

**Duties**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support bespoke software solutions, integrations, and applications for Anthesis clients.
* Develop and maintain modern web, desktop, and server\-based applications using C\#, .NET, Angular, and related technologies.
* Design and implement APIs, integration services, and automation solutions using REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, and other enterprise integration technologies.
* Work directly with customers to gather requirements, understand business processes, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Produce technical designs, specifications, deployment documentation, and support documentation to company standards.
* Take ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle, from initial concept and design through implementation, deployment, support, and continual improvement.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects, performance issues, and production incidents.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute towards coding standards, quality assurance processes, and development best practices.
* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and deployment processes.

* Good understanding of power system dynamics and the stability challenges introduced by high penetration of renewables
* Effective team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken).

jobs.description:
##### **What we do at Qliro**


At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

##### **What your team does**


We are now looking for a **Software Engineer** to join Credit \& Fraud team, the team at the center of Qliro’s Pay Later platform. What we do here shapes whether customers can pay in a way that actually works for them, and whether we protect them from taking on debt they can’t handle. It’s a dual responsibility, and we take both sides seriously.


We’re rebuilding the next generation of this system from the ground up, designed to handle a significant increase in transaction volumes as we scale. Part of what you’ll lead is making this platform ready to operate beyond the Nordics, so the architectural decisions you make now will need to hold up across multiple markets. We’re in the early stages of exploring how AI can help us make better credit and fraud decisions, and we’re honest that this is genuinely complex territory. Credit is one of the most regulated areas when it comes to AI: explainability, fairness, and auditability aren’t optional. We want someone who finds that complexity interesting, not someone who pretends it isn’t there.

##### **Current focus for the team**

* Processing tens of thousands of credit and fraud checks every day
* Running a containerized microservices architecture with daily production deployments
* Tech stack: C\#, .NET, AWS, Docker \+ Swarm, Kubernetes, Microservices, Event Driven Architecture, RabbitMQ, Terraform, GitLab, MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenTelemetry \+ Grafana, Kibana

##### **What we are looking for**

* **3\-5 years of professional experience with .NET**, with strong skills in C\#
* Comfortable using modern AI tooling such as **Windsurf**, **Claude**, or similar
* Experience in **modernizing and migrating legacy systems**
* Practical experience with agile engineering methods and solid software engineering best practices
* Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and API development
* A mindset that values **speed, correctness, and reliability**, especially in microservices and event‑driven architectures


It is beneficial if you have experience from:

* Working with **credit engines**, **credit decisioning**, or similar financial decision systems
* Working with AWS or other cloud providers
* Working in a team with full platform ownership — including monitoring, infrastructure, CI/CD, and production operations

###### **Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for \- apply now!**
